witness.branch: Heavy motor vehicle traversing a school-zone crosswalk scene
witness.quote: in an area designated as a school zone
witness.reason: The fixed school-zone crosswalk scene permits a heavy motor vehicle route within the designated area.
required_context: Establish crosswalk placement, school-property adjacency, school-zone designation and boundaries, and a supported vehicle route through the zone.
Establish person and motor-vehicle scope, school-property adjacency, zone designation and boundaries, crosswalk placement and vehicle clearance.
Establish the beacon branch or exact sign-time branch and all independent calendar, operation and class-hour facts needed to retain an active interval.
Establish the operational-beacon branch or exact sign-time branch; for a beacon, retain its associated sign and two or more alternately flashing yellow lights.
Identify the heavy-vehicle driver and establish motor-vehicle status.

Retain speed in miles per hour within the zone and the exact 15 miles per hour obligation. Beacon state alone does not resolve calendar or operation exceptions, and undefined calendar meanings and endpoint treatment remain unresolved.
Supply independent civil date, local time, session calendar, operation end and next-start times, and class hours.
witness.subject_reason: The available heavy_vehicle_driver falls within the subject when driving the constructed qualifying motor vehicle.
